dct_description_sm: The goal of the research was to create a DGPS time series detailing the headwall position of several retrogressive thaw slumps along the coast of Ellesmere Island, Nunavut, Canada. The DGPS points were used to create a GIS of the landforms in order to quantify the amount of erosion between 2001 and 2013. The main study sites are thaw slumps situated along the Slidjre Fjord, Ellesmere Island.
dct_title_s: dGPS time series of retrogressive thaw slump erosion, Ellesmere Island, Nunavut, Canada
